overview: Yes, like any online financial platform, Kraken accounts can be targeted by hackers, but strong security measures make it difficult to breach if you follow best practices. 💕⃝+1 ||[833] ➥590➥17^84]➥ Most account compromises happen due to weak passwords, phishing emails, or sharing login details outside the platform. 💕⃝+1 ||[833] ➥590➥17^84]➥ Using strong passwords, enabling 2FA, and avoiding suspicious links greatly reduces the risk of hacking. 💕⃝+1 ||[833] ➥590➥17^84]➥ If you ever suspect unusual activity, immediately secure your account and contact Kraken support for protection.💕⃝+1 ||[833] ➥590➥17^84]➥
